notes.title: Changelog v0.70b
notes.content:
Finally! The camp is ready!

Now you can manage you squad before every mission. Which kind of soldiers will go with you and how many of them. How many grenades they must take to battle to win it by AOE spells spamming.

Soon (in this month) we are going to add a lot of new weapons. (It's already playable in unstable dev build).

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/284099968506585935/CB77343AE2D049CDFB4FE67E9C92D7D6925B8DF5/[/img]

The gameplay now felt more better than ever.
In general: you can create the MEGA SUPER MAN, with 20 rocket and 20 grenades and with armor and, finally, with a sword. And that MSM will cost like 5-7 other guys.
But this is not a good idea. Because of fog of war and enemies overwatch zones you need a loot of cheap guys to create "light" and control the table and take the damage from overwatch to them.

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/284099968506586775/80B8A55B3703CB1470DFB61100BA21E33D6C6710/[/img]

Try new build, wait new weapons and war gears soon. Thank you=)

p.s. In very unstable branch I had driven some tanks today ;)

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/284099968506587250/37ECE2D76B2FB34D7CA7CDBD5272D39885E6CB68/[/img]

tags.feature: Now you can manage you squad before every mission. Which kind of soldiers will go with you and how many of them. How many grenades they must take to battle to win it by AOE spells spamming.
Soon (in this month) we are going to add a lot of new weapons. (It's already playable in unstable dev build).
In general: you can create the MEGA SUPER MAN, with 20 rocket and 20 grenades and with armor and, finally, with a sword. And that MSM will cost like 5-7 other guys.
Try new build, wait new weapons and war gears soon. Thank you=)
p.s. In very unstable branch I had driven some tanks today ;)

notes.title: Changelog v0.6b
notes.content:
[img]http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/318997942485311183/C04BA7F8185FB8A5C6A1FEFEC6025E27EE17454C/[/img]

Today we publish one of the most technically demanding updates, which separate the Steam Squad from the full version. It is the destroyable environment.

Now fences and sand sacks (and some other things) can be totally destroyed by grenades (or by any other explosive weapon). Also some of houses now also can be damaged and partially destroyed.

Soon we going to add more destroyable obstacles and houses. (It's just problem of new animation and level design testing).

In next major update we going to add meta-game camps, in which you will be able to manage your troops and weapons.

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/318997831915408100/51910C64646F71D2368736982A0C8205325C4001/[/img]

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/318997831915411409/0968C2BEEDA8E54C50BBF2860CBD11F41588E2D7/[/img]

notes.title: Changelog v0.54bt
notes.content:
This week, we have completely redesigned the animator of soldiers. Now soldiers can use a variety of weapons. And that brings us closer to the implementation of the camp, in which we will manage our squad before mission .

As a demonstration of the new features of animator we implemented melee weapons.

Unfortunately we do not have much time to fix all visual artifacts appeared in animation, so the new build will be published only in the test branch.

notes.title: Changelog v0.50b
notes.content:
We believe you haven’t heard from us for ages. Sorry for that, still we have an excuse - we’ve run a complete rework of the game logic, and the most important result here is that it operates completely outside the Unity workflow now. How can you benefit from it being the game's player? Well, we have big plans and a huge amount of features to implement, which were just impossible in the previous architecture. And now we’ll move forward to more exiting and interesting key features!

Let’s look what else is inside:
[olist]
[*]Thanks to the new game logic solution:
[list]
[*]The turn ends now only after all you soldiers make a move.
[*]The bug with impassable wickets was fixed.
[*]Action points are now updated in a real time.
[*]Passability map became more accurate.
[/list]

[*]New hot seat level was implemented, as well as many new models appeared across the levels (thus all levels underwent some changes, especially 1st-4th).

[*]We’ve updated the music, voices and sounds through the whole game, and added a plot video.

[*]Together with the first achievements, we’ve also introduced telemetry (that will serve to improve AI in the future!).

[*]And last but not least, we’ve added some special effects and reworked the animation, however it’s not a final version and we are going to continue our work in that direction.
[/olist]

tags.bug: The bug with impassable wickets was fixed.

tags.feature: New hot seat level was implemented, as well as many new models appeared across the levels (thus all levels underwent some changes, especially 1st-4th).
We’ve updated the music, voices and sounds through the whole game, and added a plot video.
Together with the first achievements, we’ve also introduced telemetry (that will serve to improve AI in the future!).
And last but not least, we’ve added some special effects and reworked the animation, however it’s not a final version and we are going to continue our work in that direction.

notes.title: What are we doing and what's the plan?
notes.content:
Last month our main resource (a.k.a. Andrey Mishkinis) was working on the final polishing of the game logics core.

When we are done with this the game will be stuffed with the following important features:

- Tanks and cars that are driven by soldiers. 

- Steel-and-concrete fortifications, stationary machine guns, anti-tank guns. - Soldiers are able to get out of trenches spending some of their action points. 

- In a little while they will be able to overcome small obstacles such as fences. In contrast with the previous feature, we haven't finished the animation for this bit yet. 

- Small objects can be destroyed.

Furthermore, we're modelling different weaponry now. In the release each of the nations will have a great variety of guns to choose from.

We keep on putting all the missions together (there are 30 of them excluding multiplayer arenas), which takes loads of time due to the high number of them.

What won't be included in the forthcoming upgrade, but will be presented in the release?

- You can choose and equip your soldiers before each mission.

- Multi-player

- Your soldier's skills slightly evolve in time, moreover you can name them and even see game statistics for each of your recruits. - Some large objects can be destroyed

Finally, right now we're about to upload a new build, which has much fewer bugs than the previous one. Fortunately, it will be available in the end of the week for all three main platforms.

- Small objects can be destroyed.
- You can choose and equip your soldiers before each mission.
- Multi-player
- Your soldier's skills slightly evolve in time, moreover you can name them and even see game statistics for each of your recruits.
- Some large objects can be destroyed
